note: Perp analog of options GEX — market-maker inventory + liquidation-driven forced flow, not literal options gamma.

coverage.funding_only: cluster/skew evidence thin or absent; funding (+OI/cascade) only

legend.amplify: Short-gamma analog: crowded book + dense clusters near mark — forced flow follows through. Don't fade.
legend.dampen: Long-gamma analog: balanced positioning, funding near baseline, no overhead clusters — fade extremes, expect mean-reversion.
legend.transitional: Sitting on the flip line (jumpiest) or mixed signals.
legend.flip_line: Nearest large liquidation cluster — the regime boundary (perp analog of the options gamma-flip).
legend.coverage: full = real MM/cluster read; funding_only = state rests on funding (+OI/cascade) alone, treat as low-evidence; none = nothing to score on.
legend.rules_version: Scoring rule-set id — a change here, not the market, may move states.
legend.since: ISO time the current state was first committed for this coin (forward-only from 2026-09-09).

regime_legend.amplify: Short-gamma analog: crowded book + dense clusters near mark — forced flow follows through. Don't fade.
regime_legend.dampen: Long-gamma analog: balanced positioning, funding near baseline, no overhead clusters — fade extremes, expect mean-reversion.
regime_legend.transitional: Sitting on the flip line (jumpiest) or mixed signals.
regime_legend.flip_line: Nearest large liquidation cluster — the regime boundary (perp analog of the options gamma-flip).
regime_legend.coverage: full = real MM/cluster read; funding_only = state rests on funding (+OI/cascade) alone, treat as low-evidence; none = nothing to score on.
regime_legend.rules_version: Scoring rule-set id — a change here, not the market, may move states.
regime_legend.since: ISO time the current state was first committed for this coin (forward-only from 2026-09-09).

distribution_legend.window_days: Trailing window the percentile ranks are computed over (capped by history).
distribution_legend.history_days: How much history actually exists for this coin (sample_count / 24).
distribution_legend.status: 'warming' until 2 days of hourly samples exist — all *_pctile null until then.
distribution_legend.sample_ts: Unix ms of the last hourly ring sample for this coin (the percentile ranks re-rank every ~5-min build; only the SAMPLING is hourly).
distribution_legend.near_density_pctile: Percentile rank of the near-mark cluster density (fuel within ±5% of mark) vs the coin's own trailing window.
distribution_legend.abs_dist_to_flip_pctile: Percentile rank of |distance to the gamma flip|. LOW = unusually close to the flip line.
distribution_legend.mm_skew: Normalized dealer inventory: mm_net_delta / mm_gross (−1 all-short … +1 all-long). Note: net/gross, not net/OI.
distribution_legend.mm_skew_pctile: Percentile rank of the signed MM skew vs the coin's own trailing window.
distribution_legend.mm_skew_z: Z-score of the live MM skew vs the coin's trailing-window mean/std (null while warming or if the window is constant).
distribution_legend.regime_score_pctile: Percentile rank of the amplify/dampen composite score (high = unusually amplify-leaning).
distribution_legend.funding_rate_pctile: Percentile rank of the signed funding rate vs the coin's own trailing window. null while warming AND when funding_pinned is true.
distribution_legend.funding_pinned: true when >= 18 of the last 24 hourly funding samples sit within 1e-07 of HL's 1.25e-05 interest baseline (a pinned series carries no crowding information); null until 24 samples exist.

maintenance_margin_tiers.note: Hyperliquid's live margin tiers per coin (meta.marginTables). maintenance_margin_pct = 50 / max_leverage (half the initial margin at the tier's max leverage); maintenance margin = notional x pct / 100 - maintenance_deduction_usd. Reference only: liquidation cluster prices are the exact on-chain liquidationPx.

regime.rationale: funding near baseline; no cluster near mark; flip line far from mark; balanced positioning (mm skew mid-range)
